Act as the primary escalation point for the team and as incident lead for major security incidents, coordinating triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews with relevant teams. Define, track, and report SOC metrics and KPIs, such as alert volumes, mean time to detect, mean time to respond, and false positive rates. Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats. Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus. Experience leading or working in a 24/7 or follow-the-sun SOC, including managing shift schedules and remote teams across time zones. Strong experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, GSOM, CISSP, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus. The organization is transitioning away from a shared technology environment and establishing its own independent Microsoft 365 tenant. This position will play a key role in planning and executing that separation, including migrating messaging, collaboration, identity, and endpoint services. Following the migration, this individual will be responsible for the ongoing administration, security, optimization, and development of the Microsoft 365 platform. This is a hands-on technical position with significant ownership and autonomy. The ideal candidate has personally performed complex Microsoft 365 migrations and is comfortable taking responsibility for both the initial transition and ongoing platform operations. Key Responsibilities -- Plan and execute a Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and associated identity services. -- Manage technical migration activities, including discovery, tenant configuration, data migration, identity and domain transitions, cutover planning, and post-migration validation. Support the transition of endpoint management and device configurations through Microsoft Intune. -- Establish and maintain Microsoft 365 administration, security, governance, and operational standards. -- Manage Entra ID, including identity synchronization, authentication, access controls, and Conditional Access policies. -- Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation to support migrations, administration, and ongoing operations. -- Troubleshoot complex Microsoft 365 issues across messaging, collaboration, identity, and endpoint services. -- Work with internal stakeholders and external technology partners during the transition, with responsibility for bringing ongoing platform management in-house. -- Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, performance, and the end-user experience. Required Qualifications -- Strong hands-on experience administering and engineering enterprise Microsoft 365 environments. -- Demonstrated experience personally executing Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations , including migration planning, technical execution, cutover, and validation. -- Experience migrating and supporting Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams. -- Strong understanding of Entra ID (Azure AD), identity management, authentication, and Microsoft 365 tenant configuration. -- Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint/device management. -- Proficiency with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration, automation, and migration activities. -- Experience working in environments with established security, compliance, and governance requirements. -- Ability to work independently, troubleshoot complex issues, and take ownership of technical projects from planning through completion. Why Consider This Opportunity? This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of a significant Microsoft 365 transformation rather than simply maintain an existing environment. You'll be involved in establishing an independent tenant, making key technical decisions, and building the foundation for how the organization manages Microsoft 365 moving forward. The role offers meaningful technical ownership, direct involvement in a major migration, and the opportunity to help shape the organization's long-term Microsoft 365 strategy and operations.
